title: Phase 1: Prove the serverless conversation foundation
description:
Outcome: a household user can address a named bot and receive one durable streamed answer while application compute retains no idle floor.

Scope: feasibility test 1, the computerless model path, durable channel and turn state, SQS delivery, and turn-scoped SSE.

Not included: computer tools, browser authority, Kanbus task integration, snapshots, and the full web application.

Complete when the transport result is recorded and the thin computerless turn passes its executable specifications end to end.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Derived from docs/ROADMAP.md immediate build order steps 1 and 2. Scale-to-zero, DynamoDB, one-turn SSE, and no persistent sockets remain requirements; this phase does not reopen them.
